name: Finder Goshi no DISTANCE
source:
My name is Miyakawa Hideki. I'm a regular 2nd year student at Kawaguchi Academy. I'm also a member of the editorial staff for the Kawaguchi Academy newspaper club which releases a weekly Monday paper. For the good of all the male academy students, I along with the club leader Anna and the apprentice Bunko spend everyday going after the kind of scoops that will give the guys a bulge in their pants!

And my name is Nagasaki Bunko. I escaped from the evil hands of Iwase the gym teacher, and now my senior club members are going to let me try and get the scoop on Iwase's violent acts against our fellow students from the scene of the incidents!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ032168.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的名字是宫川英树。我是川口学园的普通二年级学生。我也是川口学院报纸俱乐部的编辑人员，该俱乐部每周一发行报纸。为了所有男学院学生的利益，我和社长安娜以及学徒文库每天都在寻找那种能让男生裤子鼓起来的勺子！

我的名字是长崎文库。我逃离了体育老师岩濑的魔掌，现在我的前辈们要让我尝试从事件现场了解岩濑对我们同学的暴力行为！
